name: Mascot Sticker Pack
description: Full Telegram / messaging sticker pack (~32 die-cut stickers) built around one featureless brand mascot. Identity is locked across every sticker via a single neutral master shot passed as --ref on every generation, so a translucent-jelly / clay / plush character stays on-model across 30+ poses. Emotion is carried by POSE + PROP + minimalist eye-marks, never a literal mouth/nose; each sticker reproduces a recognizable chat meme (table-flip, this-is-fine, sigma, 4-arms-busy, beg). Generated on flat chroma-green WITHOUT a baked outline, then soft-keyed by flood-fill connectivity + Gaussian feather, despilled, cropped to the solid bbox, and scaled to a 512px long side (never padded to a square). gemini-3-pro-image holds the character; gpt-5.4-image-2 is reserved only for the one text-bearing sticker. Two deliverable sets ship from one render pass: white-die-cut-outline and clean-silhouette.
referenceNotes: Supply ONE neutral mascot master shot; it is passed as --ref on every generation to lock the character across all stickers.

slots.description: One-sentence physical description of the mascot (material, head/limb shape, glow).
Absolute path to the ONE neutral identity-anchor PNG, passed as --ref on every gen.
Render look, e.g. 'soft 3D clay Blender figurine, glossy softbox light, gentle AO'.
Flat keying background. '#00b140' chroma green by default; '#dcd7cf' warm grey only for an outlined set.
Expression vocabulary as eye-marks, e.g. '^^ happy / -- flat / xx dead / heart / wink / closed'.
The ONE sticker (if any) needing a crisp rendered letter/word; route to gpt-5.4-image-2.

doNotCopyLiterally: Generate clean-on-green from the FIRST sticker (no baked outline) so one pass serves both deliverable sets. Key the background by flood-fill connectivity, never segment the subject (u2net cuts the outline off). Soft alpha + crop to solid bbox + scale long side to 512, never pad to a square.
stackSummary: google/gemini-3-pro-image-preview for character-consistent stickers via a single --ref anchor (~$0.15/image); openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 for the one text-bearing sticker only. Local PIL/ffmpeg cutout + sizing. No video/VO/music. ~$6.5 total.
